name: Algorithmic Diffusion Signature
description: A lethal ghost-hunting apparatus explicitly tracking next-generation AI (Midjourney/Stable Diffusion). Unlike old GAN models which constantly shatter structural geometries, Diffusion synthesizes visual reality by iteratively 'denoising' sheer static. This procedure engineers a god-like hyper-realism that fundamentally shatters physical optical boundaries, permanently leaving an unforgeable synthetic 'Spectral Fingerprint' in the background noise matrix.
algorithm: Diffusion Denoising Spectral Variance (Spectral Power Extraction)
mechanism: It interrogates the velocity of spectral energy decay (PSD - Power Spectral Density) spanning from low to high macro-frequencies. While organic lighting physics dictate a beautifully chaotic, textured energy falloff on a camera sensor, Diffusion AI relies on injecting systematic continuous Gaussian noise steps. Consequently, every single Midjourney/Flux creation suffers precisely the same degenerative terminal illness: violently sheared, impossibly smooth, or aggressively severed ultra-microscopic frequencies.
parameters: Reactor Core: Power Spectral Density (PSD) Radar, Anomaly Intersector: Frequency Stepping Fingerprints, Model: Gaussian
accuracy: Extremely High (85-94%) - The supreme terminator, forged exclusively to obliterate the hyper-realistic, pristine artistic hallucinations pumped out by modern Generative AI gods.
source: Corvi et al. (2023) - Discrete Synthetic Footprints of Diffusion Models
useCase: Smashes the flawless facade of impossibly perfect digital artwork, instantly tearing off its beautiful mask to expose inorganic, sterile noise structures originating from machine learning vats.

references.title: Corvi, R., et al. (2023). On the detection of synthetic images generated by diffusion models. ICASSP.
Ricker, J. et al. (2022). Towards the Detection of Diffusion Model Deepfakes.
Sha, Z. et al. (2023). DE-FAKE: Detection and Attribution. ACM CCS.
Wang, Z. et al. (2023). DIRE for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection. ICCV.

strengths:
• Entirely blind to the subjective 'beauty' of the image. No matter how perfectly an AI hallucinates artificial freckles or pores, the scanner stares straight down into the mathematical wave signals.
• Acts as an executioner functionally designed to butcher Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 3, and Midjourney creations via their profane frequency histograms.
limitations:
• Deflected entirely if the malicious actor weaponizes aggressive analog Film Grain emulation software (like Dehancer) to brutally plaster layers of organic-looking synthetic chaos over the diffusion signature.
• Stripped of its power if the image is violently compressed through WhatsApp/Instagram, which obliterates the delicate spectral decay footprints.
